text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C324 · Code listings 7.1–7.2: FDTD detector simulation + shared parameters

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Chapter 7 — Detectors · Sec. 7.7 Code listings (book pp. 283–285) · Lumerical scripts (.lsf)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.1 · detector_FDTD.lsf — step 1: optical 3D FDTD of the Ge detector

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Loads shared parameters (Listing 7.2); draws oxide, two Si layers, Ge and a metal cathode.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: In this optical model the cathode is a perfect conductor (PEC), not a real metal.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Adds the FDTD region, finer-mesh zones, and a mode source injected into the silicon.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Four field monitors: two top views (one near the Ge-metal interface) and two cross-sections.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: A CW generation object turns absorbed light into an e-h pair generation rate in the Ge ...

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: ... and exports it to a file, so DEVICE can do the electrical modelling next.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: After the run it plots |Ex| field maps from each monitor and saves the results.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.2 · detector_setup_parameters.lsf — one parameter file for FDTD and DEVICE

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Geometry: 0.22 µm Si layers, 0.5 µm thick Ge, 10 µm oxide, metal contact sizes.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Doping: a p-epi region plus p and n++ contact diffusion profiles (for the electrical run).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Mesh and region limits, a Newton solver, and transient timing (step-on light, up to 1 ns).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Wavelength 1.55 µm and the file names that carry generation data from FDTD to DEVICE.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: FDTD = optical field solver · DEVICE = electrical (carrier) solver · e-h pair = electron-hole pair.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Takeaway: light is simulated first (FDTD); its generation map feeds the electrical model.
